test_title: PYST 28: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Evening)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All balls are plastics items.

2. All utensils are balls.

**Conclusions:**

I. All utensils are plastic items.

II. Some balls are not plastic items.

options.text: Bothe conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
According to the given statement,

1. All balls are plastics items.

2. All utensils are balls.
